blocks.zh: 導論與核心概念
blocks.en: Introduction and Core Concepts

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Single-Use Technology (SUT，單次使用技術) 的產業背景，以及它如何同時降低風險、縮短建廠時間並減少資本投入
blocks.en: Understand the industry background of Single-Use Technology (SUT) and how it reduces risk, shortens facility build time and lowers capital investment at the same time

blocks.zh: 掌握本指引的目的與範圍，了解它涵蓋哪些應用場景（液態儲轉、細胞培養、填充封裝等），並清楚指引的使用前提
blocks.en: Grasp the purpose and scope of this guide, know which applications it covers (liquid storage and transfer, cell culture, fill/finish, etc.), and be clear about the prerequisites for using it

blocks.zh: 熟悉本指引三大核心章節的結構：第2章組件選擇與設計、第3章導入與使用、第4章計畫管理
blocks.en: Become familiar with the structure of the guide's three core chapters: Chapter 2 Component Selection and Design, Chapter 3 Implementation and Use, Chapter 4 Project Management

blocks.zh: 精確掌握 SUT 關鍵詞彙的定義，區分 Extractables（萃出物）、Leachables（溶出物）、SUS、SUA 等易混淆概念
blocks.en: Know the definitions of key SUT terms precisely and distinguish easily confused concepts such as Extractables, Leachables, SUS and SUA

blocks.zh: 理解毒理學相關閾值（AET、TTC、QT、SCT）的層級關係，為後續相容性評估建立基礎認識
blocks.en: Understand the hierarchy of the toxicological thresholds (AET, TTC, QT, SCT) as a foundation for the later compatibility assessments

blocks.zh: 能夠辨別「Single-Use（單次使用）」與「Disposable（拋棄式）」兩個術語的實質差異，避免在 GMP 文件中混用
blocks.en: Be able to tell the real difference between the terms "Single-Use" and "Disposable" and avoid mixing them in GMP documents

blocks.zh: 1.1 Background（背景）
blocks.en: 1.1 Background

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 的三大驅動力
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Drivers of SUT

blocks.zh: Single-Use Technology (SUT，單次使用技術) 之所以在生技製藥產業快速崛起，是因為它同時解決了傳統不鏽鋼設備的三大痛點：
blocks.en: Single-Use Technology (SUT) has risen quickly in the biopharmaceutical industry because it addresses three pain points of traditional stainless steel equipment at once:

blocks.zh: Risk（風險）：免除清潔驗證 (cleaning validation) 的交叉污染風險，每批次使用全新設備
blocks.en: Risk: removes the cross-contamination risk tied to cleaning validation, because every batch uses brand-new equipment

blocks.zh: Investment（投資）：不需安裝固定管路、減少 CIP/SIP 基礎設施，資本支出大幅降低
blocks.en: Investment: no fixed piping to install and less CIP/SIP infrastructure, so capital expenditure drops substantially

blocks.zh: Time（時間）：設施建置期縮短，特別適合臨床批次快速啟動或緊急藥品生產
blocks.en: Time: shorter facility build time, which suits rapid start-up of clinical batches or urgent drug production particularly well

blocks.zh: 本指引的適用起點：組織已完成財務評估，並決定採用 SUT——不討論「要不要用」，而是「怎麼用得好」。
blocks.en: Starting point for applying this guide: the organization has completed its financial evaluation and decided to adopt SUT. The guide does not discuss "whether to use it" but "how to use it well".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 SUT 想像成「外送便當盒」對比傳統「瓷器餐盤」：瓷器餐盤耐用、可多次使用，但每次用完要清洗、消毒、檢查有無破損（對應 CIP/SIP + 清潔驗證）。外送便當盒用完即丟，省去清洗麻煩，但若亂選便當盒材質，食物可能吸收塑化劑——這正是 SUT 最大的合規挑戰：材料相容性與溶出物管控。
blocks.en: Think of SUT as a takeout lunch box versus traditional porcelain dinnerware. Porcelain is durable and reusable, but after every use it must be washed, disinfected and checked for damage (equivalent to CIP/SIP plus cleaning validation). A takeout box is thrown away after use, which saves the cleaning effort, but if you choose the wrong box material, the food may absorb plasticizers. This is exactly SUT's biggest compliance challenge: material compatibility and control of leachables.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 原文強調 SUT 是「revolutionary technology that is flexible, continues to evolve」。這意味著法規指引永遠落後於技術發展，實務上需要仰賴供應商與使用者之間的緊密溝通，而非單純照抄法規條文。
blocks.en: The original text stresses that SUT is a "revolutionary technology that is flexible, continues to evolve". This means regulatory guidance will always lag behind technical development, so in practice you need close communication between suppliers and users rather than simply copying regulatory text.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用洞察
blocks.en: CDMO Application Insights

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO（委託開發製造）而言，SUT 的靈活性尤其有價值：不同客戶的產品在同一廠房快速切換，SUT 的「用後即丟」特性天然解決了多產品廠的交叉污染疑慮，也大幅減少品種切換 (changeover) 的清潔驗證負擔——這是 CDMO 選擇 SUT 的核心商業理由。
blocks.en: For a CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization), the flexibility of SUT is especially valuable. Products for different clients are switched quickly in the same facility, and the "discard after use" nature of SUT naturally addresses cross-contamination concerns in a multi-product plant. It also greatly reduces the cleaning validation burden of changeover, which is the core business reason a CDMO chooses SUT.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Purpose and Objectives（目的與目標）
blocks.en: 1.2 Purpose and Objectives

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「第一次就做對」的哲學
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "Right the First Time" Philosophy

blocks.zh: 原文反覆強調 "done right the first time" 與 "minimize surprises"，這不只是口號，而是 SUT 專案失敗的主要模式：
blocks.en: The original text repeatedly stresses "done right the first time" and "minimize surprises". This is more than a slogan; it reflects the main ways SUT projects fail:

blocks.zh: 初期省略相容性測試 → 量產後發現溶出物超標 → 整批報廢
blocks.en: Compatibility testing skipped early on, leachables found above limits after scale-up, entire batch scrapped

blocks.zh: 組件設計時未考慮整體流路 → 後期需大幅修改組裝圖
blocks.en: Component design ignores the overall flow path, so the assembly drawings need major rework later

blocks.zh: 供應商未事先確認交貨週期 → 臨床批次延期
blocks.en: Supplier lead times not confirmed in advance, clinical batch delayed

blocks.zh: 這份指引的核心價值：用別人踩過的坑，避免你自己重蹈覆轍。
blocks.en: The core value of this guide: learn from other people's mistakes so you do not repeat them yourself.

blocks.zh: SUT 設計就像蓋房子：若設計師每次只看眼前的「這扇門要放哪裡」，而忘記整棟房子的動線，最後可能發現廚房門撞上冰箱。SUT 的高彈性（每個組件都可以更換）反而是個陷阱——越容易改，越容易在細節中迷失大局。
blocks.en: Designing an SUT is like building a house. If the designer only looks at "where does this door go" each time and forgets the circulation of the whole house, you may end up with the kitchen door hitting the refrigerator. The high flexibility of SUT (every component can be swapped) is in fact a trap: the easier it is to change, the easier it is to get lost in the details and lose sight of the big picture.

blocks.zh: 範圍說明：本指引覆蓋從液態儲轉到 Fill/Finish 的完整 SUT 應用鏈。特別注意 Fill/finish（無菌分裝） 被明確列入範圍——這是無菌藥品製造 CDMO 最關鍵的應用場景，也是監管審查最嚴格的環節。
blocks.en: Scope: The guide covers the full SUT application chain from liquid storage and transfer to Fill/Finish. Note that fill/finish (aseptic filling) is explicitly included in the scope. This is the most critical application for a sterile drug product CDMO and also the step under the strictest regulatory scrutiny.

blocks.zh: E&L 研究的重要性：「Learning when and how to perform effective extractables and leachables studies」被列為首要效益，可見 E&L 是 SUT 實施的核心技術門檻。
blocks.en: Importance of E&L studies: "Learning when and how to perform effective extractables and leachables studies" is listed as the first benefit, which shows that E&L is the core technical hurdle in implementing SUT.

blocks.zh: 對於無菌 Fill/Finish CDMO，SUT 的範圍直接涵蓋核心業務：袋裝灌裝、拋棄式過濾器、一次性管路系統。導入前必須建立清晰的供應商審核流程（第3章）與 E&L 評估標準（第2章），否則「靈活性」將演變為「不可控性」。
blocks.en: For a sterile Fill/Finish CDMO, the scope of SUT directly covers the core business: bag filling, disposable filters and single-use tubing systems. Before implementation you must establish a clear supplier audit process (Chapter 3) and E&L assessment criteria (Chapter 2); otherwise "flexibility" turns into "loss of control".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前 SUT 應用覆蓋上表中的哪幾個場景？哪些場景尚未導入，原因是什麼？
blocks.en: Which of the scenarios in the table above does SUT cover at your site today? Which scenarios have not been implemented yet, and why?

blocks.zh: 在 SUT 導入專案中，你曾遇過哪些「事後才發現的驚喜 (surprises)」？如何在下個專案中提早識別？
blocks.en: In SUT implementation projects, what "surprises" have you discovered only after the fact? How can you identify them earlier in the next project?

blocks.zh: 1.3 Structure of the Guide（指引結構）
blocks.en: 1.3 Structure of the Guide

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三章架構的邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Logic of the Three-Chapter Structure

blocks.zh: 三大章節對應 SUT 導入的三個主要活動流：
blocks.en: The three chapters correspond to the three main activity streams of SUT implementation:

blocks.zh: 第2章 — 選擇與設計：供應商主導，使用者積極參與。重點是「選什麼」「如何設計」。
blocks.en: Chapter 2: Selection and Design: supplier-led, with active user participation. The focus is "what to choose" and "how to design it".

blocks.zh: 第3章 — 導入與使用：使用者主導，供應商提供支援。重點是「如何讓它在工廠正常運作」——包含驗證、培訓、供應鏈。
blocks.en: Chapter 3: Implementation and Use: user-led, with supplier support. The focus is "how to make it work properly in the plant", including validation, training and supply chain.

blocks.zh: 第4章 — 計畫管理：貫穿整個專案的橫向管理活動。風險管理、變更管理、時程控制。
blocks.en: Chapter 4: Project Management: horizontal management activities that run through the entire project: risk management, change management and schedule control.

blocks.zh: 這個架構反映了一個重要的責任分工原則：選購時供應商是專家，導入後使用者必須成為主人。
blocks.en: This structure reflects an important principle of division of responsibility: at purchase the supplier is the expert; after implementation the user must become the owner.

blocks.zh: 這三章就像新廠開工的三個階段：第2章是「採購與設計圖」，第3章是「施工與驗收」，第4章是「專案經理全程盯場」。少了任何一章，都可能讓 SUT 專案功虧一簣。
blocks.en: The three chapters resemble the three phases of starting up a new plant: Chapter 2 is "procurement and design drawings", Chapter 3 is "construction and acceptance", and Chapter 4 is "the project manager watching the site throughout". Without any one of them, an SUT project can fail just short of success.

blocks.zh: 原文強調「strong collaboration between the suppliers and the end-users」——SUT 不是買了就能用的產品，而是需要雙方持續溝通的合作關係。這意味著採購合約中必須明確規範「資訊共享義務」，包括材料變更通知、批次測試數據、E&L 研究結果等。
blocks.en: The original text stresses "strong collaboration between the suppliers and the end-users". SUT is not a product you can use as soon as you buy it; it is a collaborative relationship that needs continuous communication from both sides. This means the purchase contract must clearly set out "information sharing obligations", including notification of material changes, batch test data and E&L study results.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在 SUT 供應鏈中扮演雙重角色：對客戶而言是「製造服務提供者」，對 SUT 供應商而言是「高要求的技術終端使用者」。建議建立 SUT 供應商資格管理 (Supplier Qualification) 程序，將第2、3章的要求轉化為內部 SOP，並在客戶技術協議中明確 SUT 相關的品質責任分工。
blocks.en: A CDMO plays a dual role in the SUT supply chain: to its clients it is a "manufacturing service provider", and to SUT suppliers it is a "demanding technical end user". We recommend establishing a Supplier Qualification procedure for SUT suppliers, turning the requirements of Chapters 2 and 3 into internal SOPs, and clearly defining the allocation of SUT-related quality responsibilities in client technical agreements.

blocks.zh: 1.4 Key Concepts/Terms — 毒理與相容性術語（第一組）
blocks.en: 1.4 Key Concepts/Terms: Toxicology and Compatibility Terms (Group 1)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：E&L 的根本差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Fundamental Difference in E&L

blocks.zh: Extractables（萃出物） 與 Leachables（溶出物） 是 SUT 安全評估的核心雙概念，必須嚴格區分：
blocks.en: Extractables and Leachables are the two core concepts of SUT safety assessment and must be strictly distinguished:

blocks.zh: Extractables：在「極端條件」（高濃度溶劑、高溫、長時間）下從材料中強制萃取出的化合物。是材料本身的特性，與實際產品無關。由供應商提供測試數據。
blocks.en: Extractables: compounds forcibly extracted from a material under "extreme conditions" (high-concentration solvents, high temperature, long duration). They are a property of the material itself and are independent of the actual product. The supplier provides the test data.

blocks.zh: Leachables：在「實際使用條件」（正常儲存、正常接觸）下遷移進入藥品的化合物。是材料 + 藥品組合的特性，必須針對具體產品測試。
blocks.en: Leachables: compounds that migrate into the drug product under "actual use conditions" (normal storage, normal contact). They are a property of the material plus drug product combination and must be tested for the specific product.

blocks.zh: 簡單記憶：Extractables 是「最壞情況」，Leachables 是「真實情況」。Leachables 通常是 Extractables 的子集。
blocks.en: A simple way to remember: Extractables are the "worst case" and Leachables are the "real case". Leachables are usually a subset of Extractables.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：AET 的作用
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Role of the AET

blocks.zh: Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET，分析評估閾值) 是分析化學與毒理學的橋樑：AET 之上的未知化合物，必須進行鑑別、定量，並報告進行潛在毒理評估；AET 之下的化合物，可以「報告但不鑑別」。
blocks.en: The Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET) is the bridge between analytical chemistry and toxicology. Unknown compounds above the AET must be identified, quantified and reported for potential toxicological assessment; compounds below the AET can be "reported but not identified".

blocks.zh: 例外情況（需個別評估）：PAH（多環芳烴）、MBT（巰基苯并噻唑）、N-亞硝胺——這三類是已知的高毒性/致癌物，不適用「低濃度可忽略」的邏輯。
blocks.en: Exceptions (require individual assessment): PAHs (polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons), MBT (mercaptobenzothiazole) and N-nitrosamines. These three groups are known to be highly toxic or carcinogenic, so the logic that "low concentrations can be ignored" does not apply.

blocks.zh: 把 CCS（容器封閉系統）想像成「藥品的家」：主包材（PPC）是直接接觸藥品的「臥室牆壁」，次包材是「外牆」——外牆若能額外隔熱（保護產品穩定性），也算 CCS 的一部分（如鋁箔袋）。相容性 (Compatibility) 評估就是確保「房子材料不會汙染居住者」。
blocks.en: Think of the CCS (container closure system) as the "home of the drug product". The primary packaging component (PPC) is the "bedroom wall" in direct contact with the drug product, and secondary packaging is the "exterior wall". If the exterior wall provides extra insulation (protecting product stability), it also counts as part of the CCS (such as an aluminum foil pouch). Compatibility assessment is about making sure the "building materials do not contaminate the occupant".

blocks.zh: 相容性 的評估範圍非常廣：不只是「材料會不會溶出毒素」，還包括活性成分被吸附 (adsorption/absorption)、輔料濃度下降、pH 變化、外觀變色等。這些互動即使不涉及毒性，也可能導致產品不符規格——同樣是 CAPA 的來源。
blocks.en: The scope of a compatibility assessment is very broad. It is not only whether the material leaches toxic substances, but also adsorption/absorption of the active ingredient, a drop in excipient concentration, pH change, discoloration and so on. Even when no toxicity is involved, these interactions can cause the product to fall out of specification, and they are likewise a source of CAPAs.

blocks.zh: 在無菌 Fill/Finish CDMO，每個新產品引入新的 SUT 組件前，必須有書面的相容性評估計畫。建議在技術轉移 (Technology Transfer) 審查中明確要求客戶提供或委託執行 E&L 研究，並在批量生產前完成 Leachables 確認。這是降低批次報廢風險的關鍵管控點。
blocks.en: At a sterile Fill/Finish CDMO, a written compatibility assessment plan is required before each new product introduces any new SUT component. We recommend explicitly requiring, in the Technology Transfer review, that the client provide or commission E&L studies, and that Leachables confirmation be completed before commercial-scale production. This is a key control point for reducing the risk of batch loss.

blocks.zh: 1.4 Key Concepts/Terms — 組件、系統與閾值術語（第二組）
blocks.en: 1.4 Key Concepts/Terms: Components, Systems and Threshold Terms (Group 2)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 層級架構（Component → Assembly → System）
blocks.en: Core Concept: The SUT Hierarchy (Component → Assembly → System)

blocks.zh: SUT 有清晰的三層結構，必須明確區分：
blocks.en: SUT has a clear three-level structure that must be distinguished explicitly:

blocks.zh: Component（組件）：最基本單元——管件、接頭、濾器、袋子
blocks.en: Component: the most basic unit, such as tubing, connectors, filters and bags

blocks.zh: Single-Use Assembly (SUA，單次使用組合件)：多個組件組合成一條完整的濕潤流路 (wetted flow path)，出廠前已滅菌。是 SUT 的核心交付物。
blocks.en: Single-Use Assembly (SUA): multiple components combined into one complete wetted flow path, sterilized before shipment. It is the core deliverable of SUT.

blocks.zh: Single-Use System (SUS，單次使用系統)：SUA + 多次使用的電控/自動化元件的整合體。SUS 是「軟硬兼施」的完整操作單元。
blocks.en: Single-Use System (SUS): an SUA integrated with reusable electrical/control and automation elements. An SUS is a complete operating unit combining "software and hardware".

blocks.zh: SUT：最廣義的術語，涵蓋以上所有層級的技術概念。
blocks.en: SUT: the broadest term, covering the technical concepts of all the levels above.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：SUA 是「用完即棄的部分」；SUS 中的電控部分（馬達、感測器）是可重複使用的。
blocks.en: Key distinction: the SUA is the "discard after use" part; the electrical and control parts of an SUS (motors, sensors) are reusable.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：毒理閾值的層級關係
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Hierarchy of Toxicological Thresholds

blocks.zh: 溶出物安全評估有三個閾值，由嚴格到寬鬆：
blocks.en: Leachables safety assessment uses three thresholds, from strictest to most lenient:

blocks.zh: SCT（安全關注閾值）：最嚴格的底線。低於此值，無論致癌或非致癌毒性均可忽略不計。
blocks.en: SCT (Safety Concern Threshold): the strictest baseline. Below this value, both carcinogenic and non-carcinogenic toxicity can be disregarded.

blocks.zh: QT（資格閾值）：低於此值，免除毒理評估——除非有 SAR（構效關係）疑慮。
blocks.en: QT (Qualification Threshold): below this value, toxicological assessment is waived, unless there is a SAR (structure-activity relationship) concern.

blocks.zh: AET（分析評估閾值）：分析化學層面的觸發點，達到或超過此值的未知物才需要鑑別量化。
blocks.en: AET (Analytical Evaluation Threshold): the trigger point at the analytical chemistry level; unknowns at or above this value must be identified and quantified.

blocks.zh: 通常 SCT ≤ QT ≤ AET——數值越低，要求越嚴格。
blocks.en: Generally SCT ≤ QT ≤ AET: the lower the value, the stricter the requirement.

blocks.zh: PPC 與 PCM 的區別：PPC 是「裝藥品的容器」（針劑注射器活塞、瓶塞），強調的是包裝完整性與最終產品接觸；PCM 是「製程中接觸藥液的管道」（軟管、濾膜、生物反應袋），強調的是製程流路中的接觸。兩者都需要 E&L 評估，但監管要求的框架略有不同（ICH Q3D、USP <661> vs BPOG/ASTM E55 系列）。
blocks.en: PPC versus PCM: a PPC is the "container that holds the drug product" (syringe plungers, vial stoppers) and the emphasis is on packaging integrity and contact with the final product; a PCM is the "conduit that contacts the drug solution during the process" (flexible tubing, filter membranes, bioreactor bags) and the emphasis is on contact within the process flow path. Both require E&L assessment, but the regulatory frameworks differ slightly (ICH Q3D and USP <661> versus the BPOG/ASTM E55 series).

blocks.zh: Proximal Materials（鄰近材料） 常被忽視：標籤油墨、黏合劑、外盒紙板也可能透過間接途徑遷移影響藥品品質，尤其對於高滲透性包材（如某些聚合物袋）。ICH Q3D 及 USP <1664> 均有對應的鄰近材料評估要求。
blocks.en: Proximal Materials are often overlooked: label inks, adhesives and outer carton board can also migrate indirectly and affect drug product quality, especially for highly permeable packaging materials (such as some polymer bags). ICH Q3D and USP <1664> both contain corresponding requirements for assessing proximal materials.

blocks.zh: SAR（構效關係）：即使某化合物濃度低於 QT，若其化學結構顯示潛在致突變性，仍需個別評估。這是 PAH、MBT、N-亞硝胺被排除在 AET 通用規則外的原因。
blocks.en: SAR (structure-activity relationship): even if a compound's concentration is below the QT, if its chemical structure indicates potential mutagenicity it still needs individual assessment. This is why PAHs, MBT and N-nitrosamines are excluded from the general AET rule.

blocks.zh: 在 SUT 供應商評估中，應要求供應商提供完整的 AET/QT/SCT 計算依據，以及 SUA 的 E&L 研究報告（通常依照 BPOG 方法論）。CDMO 的品質協議中應明確規定供應商在材料變更時的提前通知義務，因為任何 PCM 材料變更都可能觸發重新 E&L 評估，影響客戶的藥品上市時程。
blocks.en: In SUT supplier evaluation, require suppliers to provide the full basis for their AET/QT/SCT calculations and the E&L study report for the SUA (usually following the BPOG methodology). A CDMO's quality agreement should clearly state the supplier's obligation to give advance notice of material changes, because any change to a PCM material may trigger a repeat E&L assessment and affect the client's drug product launch timeline.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前如何管理 SUT 供應商的材料變更通知？是否有 SOP 明確要求供應商在變更前提前告知？
blocks.en: How does your site currently manage notification of material changes from SUT suppliers? Is there an SOP that explicitly requires suppliers to give advance notice before a change?

blocks.zh: 在評估新 SUT 供應商時，你會要求哪些 E&L 相關文件？如何判斷供應商提供的 Extractables 數據品質？
blocks.en: When evaluating a new SUT supplier, which E&L-related documents would you ask for? How do you judge the quality of the Extractables data the supplier provides?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Key Concepts/Terms — 其他重要術語（第三組）
blocks.en: 1.4 Key Concepts/Terms: Other Important Terms (Group 3)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Single-Use vs Disposable 的關鍵區別
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Key Difference Between Single-Use and Disposable

blocks.zh: 這是業界最常見的混用術語，必須在 GMP 文件中嚴格區分：
blocks.en: These are the terms most commonly mixed up in the industry, and they must be strictly distinguished in GMP documents:

blocks.zh: Single-Use（單次使用）：一個製程批次 (process run) 使用一次，批次結束即棄。不進行清潔，不考慮二次使用性能。這是 SUT 的本質定義。
blocks.en: Single-Use: used once for one process run and discarded when the run ends. No cleaning is performed and performance on reuse is not considered. This is the essential definition of SUT.

blocks.zh: Disposable（拋棄式）：廣義概念，包含單次使用，但也包括可以多次使用後再棄置的產品。多次使用的 Disposable 需要清潔、消毒，且性能隨使用次數遞減。
blocks.en: Disposable: a broader concept that includes single-use, but also covers products that can be used several times before being discarded. A multi-use disposable needs cleaning and disinfection, and its performance declines with each use.

blocks.zh: 實務啟示：若 GMP 文件寫「disposable tubing set」，監管審查員可能詢問「是否驗證過多次使用的性能」——改寫為「single-use tubing set」可避免此歧義。
blocks.en: Practical implication: if a GMP document says "disposable tubing set", a regulatory inspector may ask whether performance over multiple uses has been validated. Rewriting it as "single-use tubing set" avoids this ambiguity.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TTC 的毒理學定義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Toxicological Definition of TTC

blocks.zh: Threshold of Toxicological Concern (TTC，毒理關注閾值)：針對基因毒性雜質，設定每日攝取量低於此閾值時，終生癌症超額風險 < 1/100,000 是可接受的。TTC 是 ICH M7 基因毒性雜質指引的核心概念，與 SUT 的 E&L 安全評估直接相關——當溶出物被懷疑具基因毒性時，需與 TTC 比較。
blocks.en: Threshold of Toxicological Concern (TTC): for genotoxic impurities, a daily intake below this threshold is accepted as carrying an excess lifetime cancer risk of < 1/100,000. TTC is a core concept of the ICH M7 guideline on genotoxic impurities and is directly relevant to E&L safety assessment of SUT: when a leachable is suspected to be genotoxic, it must be compared with the TTC.

blocks.zh: Upstream/Downstream 的簡單記憶法：把生物製程想像成「上游：農場（種植細胞、培養生長）→ 下游：食品工廠（純化、濃縮、配製）」。上游在生物反應器（Bioreactor）收穫之前；下游從收穫後的過濾、層析、配製，一直到無菌分裝。SUT 在兩個階段均有廣泛應用，但各有側重的組件類型。
blocks.en: A simple way to remember upstream/downstream: picture the bioprocess as "upstream: the farm (growing cells, culturing) → downstream: the food factory (purification, concentration, formulation)". Upstream ends at harvest from the bioreactor; downstream runs from post-harvest filtration, chromatography and formulation through to aseptic filling. SUT is widely used in both stages, but each emphasizes different types of components.

blocks.zh: Support Equipment/Systems 雖非 SUT 本身，但直接影響 SUT 的操作可靠性。例如，受限進入屏障系統 (Restricted Access Barrier System, RABS) 與一次性手套口袋的接口設計，是無菌 Fill/Finish 的關鍵整合點。溫控系統（加熱/冷卻）若失效，可能影響 SUT 組件的機械完整性，進而引發系統洩漏。
blocks.en: Support Equipment/Systems are not SUT themselves but directly affect the operational reliability of SUT. For example, the interface design between a Restricted Access Barrier System (RABS) and single-use glove ports is a key integration point in sterile Fill/Finish. If a temperature control system (heating/cooling) fails, it may affect the mechanical integrity of SUT components and lead to system leaks.

blocks.zh: 無菌 Fill/Finish CDMO 的 SUT 最關鍵應用點恰好橫跨 Downstream 的末端——無菌過濾、灌裝管路、容器密封系統均屬 SUT 範疇。TTC 的概念提醒我們：對於高注射劑量（如靜脈輸注）的生物製劑，Leachables 的可接受限度比口服製劑嚴格得多，計算 AET 時的假設劑量必須基於最壞情況的臨床給藥途徑。
blocks.en: The most critical SUT applications at a sterile Fill/Finish CDMO happen to sit at the end of downstream: sterile filtration, filling tubing and container closure systems all fall within the scope of SUT. The TTC concept reminds us that for biologics given at high injection doses (such as intravenous infusion), acceptable Leachables limits are much stricter than for oral products, and the dose assumed when calculating the AET must be based on the worst-case clinical route of administration.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 SOP 中，是否明確使用「single-use」還是「disposable」？如果兩者混用，在下次 SOP 修訂時應如何標準化術語？
blocks.en: In your site's SOPs, is it clear whether "single-use" or "disposable" is used? If both are mixed, how should the terminology be standardized at the next SOP revision?

blocks.zh: 在計算溶出物的 AET 時，如何確定「最壞情況 (worst-case) 每日攝入量」？給藥途徑（靜脈 vs 皮下）對計算結果有多大影響？
blocks.en: When calculating the AET for leachables, how do you determine the "worst-case" daily intake? How much does the route of administration (intravenous versus subcutaneous) change the result?

blocks.zh: 本章重點摘要 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: SUT 的三大價值主張：降低風險（免清潔驗證）、減少投資（輕型基礎設施）、縮短時程（快速啟動）。本指引的前提：組織已決定採用 SUT，目的是「如何做對」而非「要不要做」。
blocks.en: Three value propositions of SUT: lower risk (no cleaning validation), less investment (lighter infrastructure), shorter timelines (fast start-up). The premise of this guide: the organization has already decided to adopt SUT, and the aim is "how to do it right" rather than "whether to do it".

blocks.zh: 指引架構：第2章（選擇與設計）→ 第3章（導入與使用）→ 第4章（計畫管理）。三章形成完整的 SUT 實施生命週期框架，第4章貫穿始終。
blocks.en: Guide structure: Chapter 2 (Selection and Design) → Chapter 3 (Implementation and Use) → Chapter 4 (Project Management). The three chapters form a complete SUT implementation lifecycle framework, with Chapter 4 running throughout.

blocks.zh: 術語精確性：Single-Use ≠ Disposable；SUA（組合件）≠ SUS（系統）；Extractables（實驗室強制萃取）≠ Leachables（實際使用遷移）。在 GMP 文件和供應商協議中必須嚴格使用正確術語。
blocks.en: Terminology precision: Single-Use ≠ Disposable; SUA (assembly) ≠ SUS (system); Extractables (forced extraction in the laboratory) ≠ Leachables (migration under actual use). The correct terms must be used strictly in GMP documents and supplier agreements.

blocks.zh: 毒理閾值層級：SCT（最嚴）→ QT（次嚴）→ AET（分析觸發）。TTC 針對基因毒性化合物適用，PAH/MBT/N-亞硝胺需個別評估，不適用通用閾值邏輯。
blocks.en: Hierarchy of toxicological thresholds: SCT (strictest) → QT (next strictest) → AET (analytical trigger). TTC applies to genotoxic compounds; PAHs, MBT and N-nitrosamines need individual assessment and do not fall under the general threshold logic.

blocks.zh: CDMO 核心關注點：E&L 評估是 SUT 導入的技術門檻，供應商變更管理是供應鏈風險的主要來源，SUT 的靈活性若缺乏系統化設計思維，反而成為專案延誤的根源。
blocks.en: Key concerns for a CDMO: E&L assessment is the technical hurdle for SUT implementation, supplier change management is the main source of supply chain risk, and without systematic design thinking the flexibility of SUT becomes a root cause of project delays.

blocks.zh: 供應商與使用者協作：選購階段供應商主導，導入後使用者必須成為主人。資訊共享、材料變更通知、技術支援邊界——這些都需要在品質協議中事先書面化。
blocks.en: Supplier and user collaboration: the supplier leads at the selection stage, and after implementation the user must become the owner. Information sharing, notification of material changes and the boundaries of technical support all need to be documented in advance in the quality agreement.
